legal-summariser.text:
LexBrief
Plain-English summaries of legal contracts
Reads NDAs, leases, employment and supplier contracts and returns the key obligations, termination clauses, liabilities and deadlines in plain English.

general-summariser.text:
QuickSum
Summaries of any text
Condenses articles, reports, emails and documents into short bullet-point summaries.

medical-summariser.text:
ClinNote
Clinical note and medical paper summaries
Summarises discharge notes, patient histories and medical research papers for clinicians.

invoice-extractor.text:
InvoiceGrab
Invoice and receipt data extraction
Extracts supplier, invoice number, dates, line items, tax and totals from PDF invoices and receipts into JSON.

recipe-writer.text:
ChefBot
Recipes and meal plans
Writes recipes, weekly meal plans and shopping lists for home cooks.

code-reviewer.text:
ReviewPal
Automated pull request reviews
Reviews Python and TypeScript pull requests for bugs, security issues and style problems.

summarise-lease.text:
Summarise my apartment lease
I need the main obligations, the notice period and any penalties in this 12-page residential lease agreement.

summarise-nda.text:
NDA summary
What am I agreeing to in this mutual non-disclosure agreement? List the obligations and how long they last.

summarise-article.text:
Summarise a news article
Give me five bullet points summarising this long article about interest rates.

summarise-discharge.text:
Summarise a hospital discharge letter
Summarise the diagnosis, medication changes and follow-up appointments from this discharge summary.

extract-invoice.text:
Extract invoice fields
Pull the invoice number, due date, line items and total amount out of these supplier invoices.

fix-python.text:
Review my Python PR
Check this pull request for bugs and security problems before I merge it.
